description: Build a bidirectional OSC or MIDI control surface that drives TouchDesigner params from a controller AND echoes outgoing changes back to it (motor faders, RGB pads), with an oscillation guard so the device's own echo doesn't ping-pong. Each mapping pairs a device address with a TD parameter; a Script CHOP gates outbound sends by epsilon delta, rate limit, and a last_in cache. Exposes Bypass, Globaleps, Ratehz, Reseccache custom pars on the container.

host.description: OSC remote host (device IP) for outgoing messages. Ignored for MIDI.

listenPort.description: OSC local port for incoming messages. Ignored for MIDI.

control.description: Device-side address. For OSC use the OSC path (e.g. '/track/1/fader'); for MIDI use 'cc:<num>:<chan>' (e.g. 'cc:7:1' = CC#7, channel 1).

direction.description: 'in' = device → param only; 'out' = param → device only; 'both' = bidirectional.

epsilon.description: Minimum |new - last_out| before an outgoing send is emitted. Scaled by Globaleps.

max.description: High end of the value range.

min.description: Low end of the value range.

param.description: TouchDesigner parameter to bind, written as an absolute path (e.g. '/project1/wave1/amplitude') or 'opPath.parName'.

port.description: OSC remote port for outgoing messages. Ignored for MIDI.

protocol.description: Transport: 'osc' uses OSC In/Out CHOPs; 'midi' uses MIDI In/Out CHOPs.

rateLimitHz.description: Outgoing send-rate cap (Hz). Outbound channels are throttled below this rate.

name: create_two_way_surface
title: Create two-way control surface (OSC/MIDI with feedback guard)
